text: Ichihime had been acting weird recently. Normally, she would pounce on me enthusiastically when she saw me, but for the last couple of days, she always ran back to her room immediately after returning home. This really concerned me.
I just really care about Ichihime's wellbeing. Definitely not interested in any gossip!
Not knowing what happened to Ichihime, I wanted to ask those familiar with her first. I went to Wanjirou, but he immediately asked me to forget about it.
Wanjirou
I suggest you not ask her anything.
player
Why?
See this mark on my face? She gave it to me the last time I asked. Tsk, she hit me hard.
I carefully examined Wanjirou's face and found three visible scars under his short fur. Looked like they were left by some sharp blade.
Well, I better not ask her then. Girls at her age often have some secrets, I don't want Ichihime to think that I want to spy on her.
I've known Ichihime for a long time but she has never been like this. I need to make sure she is fine.
I knocked on Ichihime's door. To my surprise, she didn't let me in, but opened the door slightly and looked at me warily.
Ichihime
Master?
Ichihime, is everything alright?
Nyaa? Ichihime doesn't know what you are talking about, Master.
You look like something's been bothering you. If you don't mind, you can talk to me about it.
Ichihime closed her door. It seemed she didn't want to talk to me.
I had no choice but to give up investigating.
I never thought that over the next few days, Ichihime's situation didn't improve but got worse. I even saw a lot of dirt on her clothes once when she rushed into the room.
Given that she didn't want to explain to us, I decided to follow her secretly to find out what she had been doing.
I pretended to be chatting with Wanjirou in the garden of Mahjong Soul Shrine. When we saw Ichihime sneaking out, Wanjirou and I exchanged looks and followed her stealthily.
Ichihime didn't go to anywhere remote. Instead, she came to the central park. It was a very busy place with lots of children playing every day.
A football suddenly flew over and hit Ichihime's head hard.
Nyaa—
Frightened Ichihime jumped out of the bush and bumped into the boy who was trying to pick up the ball.
Boy A
Woah—the monster has come again!
Hearing his screams, the boy's friends gathered over.
I am not a monster!
Girl A
Look at her ears and tail! Does she remind you of the man-eating cat monster?
Boy B
Argh—so scary!
All the kids immediately ran away, screaming. A few bold ones even picked up stones from the ground and threw at Ichihime.
Wanjirou and I rushed over to help Ichihime leave the central park.
Mahjong Soul Shrine
After returning to Mahjong Soul Shrine, I felt that Ichihime's recent behaviors probably had something to do with what happened today, so I followed Ichihime to her room.
Ichihime, do you know what the man-eater cat monster was all about?
Recently, there was this strange website-nyaa... It said a man-eating cat monster appeared in the central park, and posted an image that looked really like Ichihime.

Looked really like...? That was just a photo of Ichihime herself!!!//nThe photo looked like a sneak shot taken in the central park. There were also some notes about the cat monster written in red. It was very suspicious.
Did you go to the central park because of this rumor?
Nyaa... Ichihime is a priestess. How can I just sit and watch the cat monster hurt innocent people? I was hiding in the park, trying to protect them, but I never thought...
You never thought that they could mistaken you for the monster cat.
Master...
I saw grievance and resentment from Ichihime's eyes.//nThis incident was definitely planned and I must investigate. But what should I do?
It's time to bring my great friends
It's time to demonstrate my capabilities
When I chatted with Hana Ninomiya a few days ago, she mentioned a famous hacker "Ice" who would provide help if someone post an internet-related query on Asaha High School's forum.
Asaha High School
I took Ichihime to Asaha High School and found Hana Ninomiya, who was taking care of the garden.
Good afternoon, Hana Ninomiya.
Now that she found out why I was here, I feel a bit embarrassed to ask for help.
Master, is this the friend that you mentioned who can help us?
Hana Ninomiya
Hah, I knew you came to me looking for help.
Well, you don't look like a bad guy, so I can help you this time.
Could you help us to contact Ice?
I can, but Ice will not help you if the request may harm others.
We just want to investigate a website posting malicious rumors.
Opened the website posting the cat monster incident and showed it to Hana Ninomiya.
People really are getting more and more stupid. How could they believe in such nonsense without evidence?
As she spoke, Hana Ninomiya logged onto Asaha High School's forum and furiously typed a post.
Meanwhile, Ichihime's attention was caught by the butterflies on the flowers. She probably forgot this was all about her.
There it is!
We opened the map and found the coordinates. It was a bar named "LULLABY".
It's a bar... Only adults can get in...
Hmph...
Hana Ninomiya pushed her glasses back up her nose and put up a mysterious smile.
One hour later

We showed up at LULLABY in the most awkward way possible: Hana Ninomiya was wearing a tight buttocks skirt and a wavy wig, while Ichihime disguised herself with an oversized hat, sunglasses and a maxi dress.
Welcome to LULLABY.
While we were looking around for somewhere to sit, a young bartender came to us.
My name is Natsuki Shinomiya. I am a bartender of LULLABY.
Natsuki Shinomiya introduced himself politely and took us to a table in the corner.
A moment later, he brought us three cups of milk.
Excuse me, I don't think we ordered any milk?
Natsuki Shinomiya
Looking at his cunning smile, I knew our disguise didn't work.
My disguise had always been perfect! How did he manage to tell!?
Hana Ninomiya stared at Natsuki Shinomiya's back and mumbled.//nIchihime suddenly approached me and pointed at the milk in front of me.
Master, would you like Ichihime to help you with it?
Realizing she finished her milk long ago, I gave mine to her unwillingly.
We started to chat in the bar to kill time. As the clock pointed at 19:30, someone came in with a laptop.

It was just an ordinary young man who looked like a frequent customer. He sat at a table not far from us and turned on his laptop. We could see his screen from our table, and it happened to be that website containing Ichihime's rumor.
It's him!
Nyaa!
Wait a sec, this is a public area. Let's not make a mess.
Hana Ninomiya stopped Ichihime and I from rushing over.//nFortunately, that man seemed to be bothered by something and didn't stay long.
We followed him out of LULLABY and stopped him at an empty laneway.
Hola! You there, give us your laptop! Nyaa—!
Did you hear us?! Hurry up before we teach you a lesson the hard way!
The moment we stopped him, Ichihime and Hana Ninomiya rushed up like gangsters. The man backed off into a corner and looked at me helplessly.
Um... excuse me, we just wanted to have a look at your laptop.
Man
W-what do you want from me! I have no money. If you really have to take something, you can take my body...
...I'll just be frank. Did you make this website?
I took out my phone and opened the website. The man looked pale.
Y-yes, I made it.
To my surprise, he admitted it.
Why did you do that?
Nyaa! Why did you say that Ichihime was a monster!? Look at my claws, they are poisonous, you know? I can kill you with them!
Ichihime flaunted her claws in front of the man. He collapsed to the ground and finally spoke after a long time.

Sorry, I didn't mean to harm you. I saw your cat ears and tail in Mahjong Soul Shrine the other day, and they reminded me of the cat monster legends I heard when I was a kid. So I made this website as a joke. I never thought that...
That so many ignorant people would actually believe in it.
Right, right. I was also surprised that so many people would believe in this nonsense.
Nothing surprising. When people are bored, they start to spread rumors. The more absurd the rumors are, the more excited they get.
Yeah... What should I do now?
The internet forgets a thing within an instant. Once you change your website to a disclaimer and apologize publicly, everyone will lose interest. Soon, this will pass.
Okay.
I didn't expect this incident to be resolved so easily. Ichihime seemed to be satisfied too.
Ichihime, are you just going to let him walk like that?
Nyaa? The problem's solved, isn't it?
But you were misunderstood and hurt because of it.
I see a genuine smile on Ichihime's face. The cat ears and tail may make her look different, but this girl is more kind-hearted than anyone.

Based on my instinct developed from years of Mahjong, this must have been done by someone who had contact with Ichihime. The first suspect that came to my mind was the rabbit who just arrived at One Han City, Kaguyahime.

For some reason, she and Ichihime really couldn't get along. They almost always started to quarrel whenever they saw each other. If this incident was meant to be a prank, she could be the one behind it.
Kaguyahime's Home
I took Ichihime to Kaguyahime's home. She seemed to have just woken up and was still yawning while dragging a large hugging pillow.
Good afternoon, Kaguyahime.
Kaguyahime
Gya—! W-why are you here?! And you even brought this dwarf along!
Hah? Stupid rabbit, are you trying to start a fight again?
I had to stop them before it turned into another fight.
Easy, easy. Kaguyahime, we came here for something very urgent.
I opened the website on my phone and handed it to Kaguyahime.
Recently, we found this malicious website posting rumors about Ichihime. I'd like to know if you have anything to do with it.
Hah? Why would a great deity like me need such filthy method to deal with that dwarf? You are humiliating me.
What method?
I immediately understood Kaguyahime's plan. She sure was good at pranks.
Over the next few days, many blurry photos suddenly appeared on the internet, claiming that they had witnessed the cat monster in the central park.
When we came to the central park, Kaguyahime was sitting on a bench touching her own ears. A young man stood next to her, looking at the ground. There were many people around them.
Kaguyahime stood up and waved when she saw us.
Well, now that the victim has arrived, you can explain what you have done. Hurry up.
Kaguyahime looked to the young man. He raised his head and looked at me and Ichihime, then hesitated a while before he finally spoke.
Sorry, the website was made by me.
Nyaa?!

I didn't mean to harm you on purpose. I saw your cat ears and tail in Mahjong Soul Shrine the other day, and they reminded me of the cat monster legends I heard when I was a kid. So I made this website as a joke. I never thought that...
That you actually summoned the cat monster? Uhehe.
Y-yeah. I thought my joke would be forgotten after a few days, but I never thought that... a cat monster really showed up in the central park. I...
There is no cat monster.
What?
It was just a plan to lure you out. The photos were purposely blurred. This was the actual thing.
I took a scarecrow that had the shape of a cat monster from the bush nearby and handed it to the crowd.
So are you saying this is all fake and there is no cat monster?
Right. The cat monster never existed in the first place. Both your website and our photos were fake.
That's good... awesome... I was so worried. It's really good that the cat monster doesn't exist.
Well then, don't you have something to say?
The man thought for a while and bowed to the crowd, and to Ichihime separately.
Sorry, everyone. The cat monster wasn't real, it was just a prank that I made. I never thought it would cause you so much trouble, please forgive me.
Ichihime, don't you hate him?
Do you know why you failed?
W-why?
Kaguyahime grabbed the young man and left. Seeing them walk away, I already started to worry about One Han City's future.
Master.
Hmm?
Ichihime's promise dispelled my worries like sunshine. With her around, I'm sure everything will be all right.
However, she didn't play with the kids in the sandpit but watched them from the bush behind the bench instead.//nWe were too far away and could not see the look on her face.
Oh, it's you, {var:player_nickname}. You don't often come to me, so there must be something that you need my help with.
Central Park
Ichihime opened a website on my phone as she spoke.
It was a beautiful afternoon and I got a call from Kaguyahime. She asked me and Ichihime to go to the central park.
But you two have the same height!
But I have thought about all possibilities and you are the only one who doesn't get along with Ichihime. Who else can it be if it's not you?
A girl at her age has many secrets. Leave her alone
Ichihime is fine, I only want to sleep. Don't worry, master! You should go, nyaa!

It showed a set of coordinates and a photo that looked like it was from a surveillance camera. On the photo there was a young man whose face was covered by a cap. The time, marked in red, was "19:30".
Milk is good for kids. Also, minors are not allowed in this bar. I will let you walk this time, but never again.
Yeah... But Ichihime went to the central park to protect people in the first place. Knowing there is no cat monster, Ichihime's goal has been achieved, nyaa!
Hmph! State your business then.
Hmph! Despite your rudeness, I can still teach you a method. I am such a kind goddess.
Whoever made this website must know Miss Dwarf in person, so he or she would never expect to see a real cat monster, uhehe!
I was a bit annoyed in the beginning, but knowing the cat monster isn't real, Ichihime feels much better. As a priestess, Ichihime's duty is to protect everybody, nyaa!
Tsk!
Uhehe! Of course it's because you are still an amateur. But I see great potential in you. Let me teach you how to do great pranks, uhehe!
I heard someone clapping immediately after he spoke. To my surprise, it was Ichihime.
Don't worry-nyaa, master! As long as Ichihime is around, Ichihime will protect master and the One Han City that you love, nyaa!
Surprisingly, Kaguyahime didn't argue with Ichihime. Instead, she walked to the young man and patted his shoulder.
Half an hour later, Hana Ninomiya's phone received a message.
